formula: OLS y=a+b*x; x=log(predicted_revenue/base_revenue), y=log(actual_revenue/base_revenue); predicted growth=clip(expm1(a+b*x_current), original floor, original ceiling)
method: statistics.linear_regression; intercept included; equal company weights; no trimming, coefficient scan, or industry grouping
scope: same exposed 600 company development design, disjoint 300 calibration/300 evaluation; previous mature origin only at current cutoff; no new holdout; current forecast margin and original growth bounds fixed
cash_bridge: first-year policy NOPAT minus revenue increment / original sales_to_capital; explicit assumption, no historical FCFF or full DCF accuracy claim
stop: any gate fails: no new holdout, no coefficient/feature/weight tuning; pass permits new-company validation only
method_boundary: Damodaran discusses limits of past growth prediction; this regression is an explicit research calibration, not a prescribed valuation formula. Log back-transform is a geometric point, not an unbiased conditional mean.
